entry.title: HLTS: 8-K - Current report (other events)
entry.summary: (Fictional test filing.) Harbor Line Transit Systems Inc. Item 8.01 Other Events: the Lakeside County Transit Board selected Harbor Line as the preferred bidder for a seven-year, $85M bus-operations contract. Contract terms are still being negotiated and no definitive agreement has been signed.

entry.title: CDRS: 8-K/A - Current report, amendment
entry.summary: (Fictional test filing.) Cedar Rail Signaling Inc. Amendment No. 1 to the 8-K of November 30, filed only to attach the investor presentation as Exhibit 99.2 (Item 9.01). No change to the reported results or guidance.

entry.title: HLTS: 8-K - Current report (officer change)
entry.summary: (Fictional test filing.) Harbor Line Transit Systems Inc. Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers: Chief Executive Officer Dana Whitfield will step down effective December 31, 2026. The board named Chief Operating Officer Luis Ortega as interim CEO and has begun a search.

entry.title: CDRS: 8-K - Current report (Q3 results)
entry.summary: (Fictional test filing.) Cedar Rail Signaling Inc. Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition; Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits. Q3 revenue $318M, up 21% year over year, driven by positive-train-control upgrades; full-year revenue guidance raised to $1.22B-$1.25B.
